text.Ion Station:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 2 Trade. If you have another Trade Federation card in play, gain another 1 Trade. If you have two (or more) other Trade Federation cards in play, you also gain 4 Combat and 4 Authority. 
 Strategy ==
This card can be extremely valuable in a blue-heavy deck. With both the ally and double ally abilities enabled, this outpost generates 3 Trade, 4 Combat and 4 Authority. Considering that it only costs 5 Trade, this might well make it the best valued card in the game. If you acquire this card early in the game, it is definetely worth buying some other Trade Federation cards (preferably bases) to trigger Ion Stations ally abilities. Due to its high stats it remains useful later in the game in any predominantly blue deck. 

If you are unlikely to use its ally abilities, this card is rather expensive for what you get, although still not bad as it is still an Outpost of 5 that can keep your other bases and HQ safe.
